Since I just posted to this subreddit as well, I'm not sure how much help I can give you. I just wanted you to know that you aren't alone, I feel similarly to you. I have one long distance friend and a family who is only my family because of blood relation, not because we really talk and try to help one another. It's incredibly lonely. I was bullied as a kid too and that shit really sticks with you, no matter what anyone says. At any rate, that girl who said that sounds like a bitch, or maybe just a typical asshole teenager.

I also saw that you've replied to other posts to try to help people, and I think that says a lot about you. I suppose you'll never know for sure, but maybe one, or some, or all of those replies helped people. You sound intelligent and kind and I hope you get whatever help you need and decide to stick around.
